camel_example: aliyun cms CreateSiteMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --Address 'https://www.aliyun.com' --TaskName HanZhou_ECS1 --TaskType HTTP
kebab_example: aliyun cms create-site-monitor --address https://www.aliyun.com --task-type HTTP --task-name HanZhou_ECS1 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSiteMonitor

parameters.help_en: The URL or IP address of the monitoring task
parameters.name: address

parameters.help_en:
Site monitoring type of site monitoring task.

Valid values: HTTP(S), PING, TCP, UDP, DNS, SMTP, POP3, FTP, and WEBSOCKET
parameters.help_zh:
监控任务的监控类型。

目前站点监控任务的类型包括：HTTP（S）、PING、TCP、UDP、DNS、SMTP、POP3、FTP、WEBSOCKET
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the monitoring task.

The name must be 4 to 100 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh:
监控任务的名称。

长度4~100个字符，取值可包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和汉字
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The monitoring frequency.

Valid values: 1 minute, 5 minutes, 15 minutes, 30 minutes, and 60 minutes.

Default value: 1 minute
parameters.help_zh:
监控频率。

取值：1分钟、5分钟、15分钟、30分钟和60分钟。

默认值：1分钟
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The probe information. If this parameter is left empty, the system randomly selects three detection points.

The value is a JSON array. Example: `[{"city":"546","isp":"465"},{"city":"572","isp":"465"},{"city":"738","isp":"465"}]`, which correspond to Beijing, Hangzhou, and Qingdao.

For more information about how to obtain detection point information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115045.html
parameters.help_zh:
探针信息。如果该参数取值为空，则系统随机选择3个探测点。

格式为JSONArray，例如：`[{"city":"546","isp":"465"},{"city":"572","isp":"465"},{"city":"738","isp":"465"}]`，分别对应北京、杭州、青岛。

关于如何获取探测点信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115045.html
parameters.name: isp_cities

parameters.help_en: The advanced extension options for the protocol type of the monitoring task. Different protocol types correspond to different extension options
parameters.help_zh: 监控任务对应协议类型的高级扩展选项。不同监控任务的协议类型对应不同的扩展选项
parameters.name: options_json

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert rule.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an existing alert rule in CloudMonitor, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114941.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警规则ID。

关于如何获取云监控中已存在的报警规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114941.html
parameters.name: alert_ids

parameters.help_en: The detection point group used by the monitoring task. Different options correspond to different detection point types. PC corresponds to PC clients, MOBIEL corresponds to mobile clients, and FC corresponds to VPC internal network detection. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is PC
parameters.help_zh: 拨测任务使用的拨测点组。不同的选项对应不同的探测点类型。PC对应PC端，MOBIEL对应移动端，FC对应VPC内网探测。不设置的话默认为PC
parameters.name: agent_group

parameters.help_en: The custom detection period. You can only select a specific time period from Monday to Sunday for detection
parameters.help_zh: 自定义探测周期。只能选择周一至周日的某个时间段进行探测
parameters.name: custom_schedule

parameters.help_en: The network information required when creating a VPC internal network monitoring task. You must provide a JSON string that contains the following four fields: vpcId, vswitchId, securityGroupId, and region
parameters.help_zh: 创建vpc内网拨测任务时需要提供的网络信息。需要提供一个JSON，里边必须包含vpcId，vswitchId，securityGroupId和region四个字段
parameters.name: vpc_config

Data.description_en: The details of the monitoring task result

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:

true: The operation is successful.

false: The operation fails
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
